About

How these suites runpytest · Vitest · Playwright
Backend · pytest (API tests)

Tests in backend/tests/ call the FastAPI endpoints and services directly in-process against a test database; no browser or running server. They cover happy paths, auth failures, tenant isolation, idempotency and ledger invariants. make report-backend runs pytest with the SASAI_TEST_REPORT=1 recorder, which writes every outcome to test-reports/backend-run.json.

Frontend · Vitest (unit/component tests)

*.test.ts(x) files co-located with the admin-ui source render components into a simulated DOM (jsdom) with Testing Library; server actions are mocked, so neither a browser nor the backend is needed. They cover lib helpers and the interactive maker-checker components. make report-frontend runs Vitest's JSON reporter into test-reports/frontend-run.json.

E2E · Playwright (real browser, live stack)

admin-ui/e2e/*.spec.ts drive a real Chromium through the actual Next.js app against the live backend and Keycloak, so the whole stack must be up. A setup project logs the maker and checker admins in once and saves their storage state, so specs start authenticated; specs run serially because maker-checker flows share backend state. Every test records a screenshot and video (plus a trace on failure); each run is archived with its artifacts under test-reports/e2e-runs/ and selectable on the E2E tab, where every test case expands to its own artifacts. make report-e2e runs the suite and rebuilds this page.

How they combine

Each run leaves its JSON file in test-reports/; scripts/build_test_report.py merges whatever run files exist with git dates, Gherkin scenarios and the rolling last-3 history into this page. A stack that didn't run carries its previous results forward, so one suite can be refreshed without blanking the others.
